Messages.Text: What is a good way to structure weekly meeting notes?

content.text: What is a good way to structure weekly meeting notes?

Messages.Text: Keep three headings: **Decisions**, **Action items** (owner and date), and **Open questions**. Start each week with last week's open questions.
